body.style: display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; margin: 0; overflow-y: scroll;

xf:group.style: width: 240px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #98BED6 0%, #89B2D1 50%, #7BA6CC 100%); padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 2px 0 15px rgba(152, 190, 214, 0.3);

w2:textbox.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 24px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
w2:textbox.xf:label: MENU

xf:group.style: flex: 1; background-color: white; padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow-y: auto;
flex: 1; position: relative; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 2px; z-index: 1000; pointer-events: none;

xf:trigger.style: width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; background-color: #EC9192; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(90, 155, 212, 0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.3s ease;
